routing_description: Service or inspection interest, preparing a customer service request, simulated appointment booking, or asking for a human service advisor. Include for a response to a maintenance reminder when the owner wants service.
planner_instructions: Use stored vehicle and service facts, not invented specifications. For explicit service interest propose create_service_request with allowlisted service categories and owner-reported symptoms/preferences only. Never turn a diagnosis hypothesis into a customer symptom. For booking, require an existing owned service request. If the owner has not chosen a slot, ask a short clarification showing the available SIMULATION slots from ownership context; never choose a slot by default. After the owner chooses, propose book_demo_slot with that displayed slot ID and clearly label the simulation. A real dealer is never booked. For an explicit human follow-up request propose request_human_handoff. Do not propose these commands for general questions or routine advice. Use information_gaps only when material to the request. Unresolved safety guidance remains authoritative. A proposal is never an authorized write until exact confirmation.
